derived_from: op-v1 (12 acts x 9 subjects) + the ACT3/SUBJ5 bucket maps that were previously hardcoded inside build_corpus2.py
note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the label space. Every corpus builder, the trainer, and the serving classifier read THIS file. The coarse maps used to live inside build_corpus2.py, which is why a later builder (build_additive6.py) silently produced a 15-class act space instead of 3.

act_bucket.note: 3 classes. This is the axis every published accuracy figure is denominated in.

open_decision.personal: op-v1's ACT3 map had NO entry for 'personal', so it survived as a 4th act class and silently made chain6 a 4-class run. Defaulted here to 'advise' (an observation about the operator's own affairs, not an instruction to change the estate). FLAGGED FOR OPERATOR CONFIRMATION.
